events.descricao_en: LIVE!21K - FORTALEZA 2026 is more than a race, it is a moment of excitement and connection. You can choose between the distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km, or participate in the Kids Race. Additionally, enjoy the LIVE! Arena, which offers music, wellness activities, and exclusive activations. Register and come feel the rhythm of LIVE! RUN XP.
events.descricao_original: LIVE!21K - FORTALEZA 2026 Muito além da corrida, um momento de vibração e conexão! Escolha entre 5 km, 10 km e 21 km ou Corrida Kids e aproveite a Arena LIVE!, com música, bem-estar e ativações exclusivas. Inscreva-se e venha sentir o ritmo da LIVE! RUN XP.
